TWO WAYS TO USE LUNORI

In your browser.
Inside Codex.

The extension translates the page you are reading. The Codex plugin translates text and exposes available models and account status as tools.

Choose your setup →

A signed-in ChatGPT account and an eligible model are required. Translation uses your account’s shared plan limits.

A few useful details.

Does it require an API key?

No. The macOS companion uses official Sign in with ChatGPT and the public Responses API. Node.js 22+ and an eligible ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan are required. No Codex installation is needed.

Where does my text go?

The text you choose to translate is sent to OpenAI through the local companion. Account credentials stay on your Mac. This website does not receive page text. Read the privacy policy.

Is it available in the Chrome Web Store?

Not yet. You can install the downloadable extension in developer mode. Store publication depends on registration and Google's review; this page will link the listing when it is live.

Does it translate PDFs and videos?

This release focuses on web-page text and text sent to the Codex plugin. PDF, OCR, video subtitles, and input-field translation are not included.
